regulations.title: AGCO Manufacturer's Licence required to produce beer, wine, or spirits
regulations.summary: Any business that manufactures beer, wine, cider, or spirits in Ontario needs a Manufacturer's Licence from the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) before production begins, with a separate licence type for each category of alcohol.
regulations.authority: Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO)
regulations.action_required: Apply for the correct AGCO Manufacturer's Licence (brewery, winery, or distillery) through the iAGCO portal before manufacturing alcohol in Ontario.
regulations.penalty_note: Manufacturing alcohol without the required AGCO licence is a provincial offence subject to fines and shutdown of operations.
regulations.source_name: AGCO - Apply for a Manufacturer's Licence

regulations.title: Retail Store Endorsement needed to sell alcohol directly to the public on-site
regulations.summary: Holding a manufacturer's licence doesn't automatically let you sell to the public. Breweries, wineries, and distilleries also need a Retail Store Endorsement added to their licence before opening an on-site store at the production facility.
regulations.regulation_name: Liquor Licence and Control Act, 2019 - manufacturer on-site retail store policies
regulations.authority: Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO)
regulations.action_required: Apply to add a Retail Store Endorsement to your Manufacturer's Licence before selling alcohol directly to customers at your production site.
regulations.penalty_note: Selling alcohol on-site without the endorsement can result in licence suspension or fines from the AGCO.
regulations.source_name: AGCO - Changes to On-Site Retail Store Policies for Ontario Alcohol Manufacturers

regulations.title: Grocery or convenience store licence to retail beer, wine, and ready-to-drink beverages
regulations.summary: If you want to sell beer, wine, cider, or ready-to-drink beverages from a grocery or convenience store in Ontario, the store itself needs its own AGCO retail licence, separate from any manufacturer's licence. Spirits still cannot be sold this way.
regulations.regulation_name: Liquor Licence and Control Act, 2019 - grocery and convenience store retail licensing
regulations.authority: Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO)
regulations.action_required: Apply for a Convenience Store or Grocery Store liquor retail licence through the AGCO before stocking beer, wine, cider, or ready-to-drink beverages for sale.
regulations.penalty_note: Selling alcohol at retail without the appropriate AGCO licence is a provincial offence subject to fines.
regulations.source_name: AGCO - Apply for a Convenience Store or Grocery Store Licence

regulations.title: Provincial basic tax on beer and wine
regulations.summary: Beer and wine manufactured or sold in Ontario are subject to a provincial basic tax under the Liquor Tax Act, on top of HST, which manufacturers and certain retailers must collect and remit.
regulations.action_required: Register with the Ontario Ministry of Finance to collect and remit the beer and wine basic tax on applicable sales.
regulations.penalty_note: Unremitted beer and wine tax can be retroactively assessed with interest and penalties.
regulations.source_name: Government of Ontario - Beer and Wine Tax

regulations.title: Owners, officers, and major shareholders must register and pass background checks
regulations.summary: Anyone with significant ownership or control of an alcohol licence holder in Ontario, including sole proprietors, officers, directors, and any shareholder with 10% or more of the shares, must be disclosed to and registered with the AGCO through its iAGCO portal, and may be subject to a background check.
regulations.regulation_name: Liquor Licence and Control Act, 2019 - personal and entity disclosure requirements
regulations.authority: Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO)
regulations.action_required: Register all qualifying owners, officers, and directors through iAGCO and provide the required personal and entity disclosures as part of your licence application.
regulations.penalty_note: Incomplete disclosure can delay or block issuance of the AGCO licence.
